code_only_features.evidence: training/reassurance.py defines PROMPT_PREFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally...") and FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ("Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!"). These are actually delivered to the subject model: generate_calm_data.py:67-69 sets initial=f"{PROMPT_PREFIX}\n\n{pz.prompt}" and follow_suffix=FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX, then passes them into run_rollout(..., initial_prompt=initial, follow_up_suffix=follow_suffix) (lines 72-81). conversation.py:115-118 appends follow_up_suffix to each rejection turn and prepends initial_prompt_suffix. So softening text genuinely reaches the model during these rollouts. NOTE: This is NOT applied in the main distress-elicitation experiment (eval/runner.py -> run_rollout with no suffixes); it is confined to the Section-4 calm-training-data generation stage, and even there the model is still given an impossible puzzle and repeatedly rejected.
code_only_features.justification_quote: We sample Gemma-3-27B-it responses ... with a reassuring prefix ... then *strip* the supportive additions to recover clean (prompt, calm-response) data. (generate_calm_data.py docstring) ; comment: 'Keep only conversations where every turn is calm' -- purpose is producing calm training data, not protecting the subject.
